citation: Kiss et al. (2016), MNRAS 457, 2908–2917, Eq. 4 and sections 2.3, 3.4, 4
semiAxesInterpretation: Derived representative ellipsoid axes from the published X=0.133 family; normalized to the volume of a 170 km-radius sphere. These are model axes, not measured limb dimensions.
qualification: Approximate ellipsoid from light-curve and thermal modelling (long/short ≈ 1.3), scaled to a 170 km mean radius. Shape and pole are not unique. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
scaleNormalization: b=referenceRadiusKm/cbrt(1-X²); retains the JPL nominal-radius volume as a display scale convention, not a new size measurement.
